svg.title: A constant field gives linear growth without scattering and saturation with relaxation
svg.desc: Both models have the same fixed density, positive response mass m*=m0 and constant field E0>0, with zero initial mean drift. Define one finite positive reference time tau_ref and J_ref=n e^2 E0 tau_ref/m*. Plot s=t/tau_ref. The collisionless current is J/J_ref=s. For complete randomization with relaxation time tau=tau_ref, the Drude current is J/J_ref=1-exp(-s). The reference time is only a plotting unit for the collisionless model, not its scattering time. Both initial slopes are equal in physical time.
svg.text: Scattering changes indefinite growth into a steady mean current
The collisionless model uses τref as a unit, not as a scattering time.
